explanation: In the Netherlands, punctuality is highly valued in business settings; arriving late is seen as disrespectful and unprofessional. Dutch culture emphasizes efficiency and respect for others' time, so even a few minutes' delay can create a negative impression. It is standard practice to arrive exactly on time or a few minutes early.
local_tip: Arrive 5 minutes early to the meeting to show respect and reliability.

also_check.note: Extreme punctuality is expected; lateness is a serious breach of etiquette.
Lateness of up to 15 minutes is often tolerated in business, but it varies by region and company.
Meetings may start late due to flexible time perception, but it is still respectful to arrive on time.
